description: BioNexus development rule propositions and regime hypotheses (BNS-018). No packaged rule carries verified external endorsement, empirical calibration, or accepted challenge status.
trust_policy: External review or calibration is accepted only through bionexus.evidence-attestation.v1 verification against an explicit trust registry and artifact digest.

proposition.statement: Biological replication (n >= 3) is mandatory for population-level statistical inference; treating single-donor cells as independent samples constitutes pseudoreplication.
proposition.formal_predicate: forall g in Genes: Var_pop(Y_g) = sigma^2_donor + sigma^2_cell; n_donors >= 3
underlying_assumptions: Exchangeable donor sampling from target population

classification.rationale: Experimental design theory: with fewer replicates than the inferential design requires, between-replicate variance is unidentifiable; sample-specific batch effects confound population effects.

missing_replicates.source_citation: Fisher 1935 (Design of Experiments); Lun & Risso 2018 (single-cell pitfalls); Squair et al. 2021 (Nature Communications)

supporting_evidence.note: Squair et al. 2021: Confronting false discoveries in single-cell differential expression
Lun & Risso 2018: Single-cell differential expression workflow pitfalls

contradictory_evidence.note: Zimmerman et al. 2023: Isogenic cell lines with minimal donor variance under identical culture conditions

applicable_regimes.description: Droplet single-cell RNA-seq on primary human or mammalian tissue biopsies
Array-based spatial transcriptomics aggregated to donor/slice pseudobulk

known_counterexamples.description: Clonally derived isogenic cell line under controlled incubator conditions with zero genetic diversity
known_counterexamples.boundary_mechanism: Between-donor genetic variance component sigma^2_donor is zero by definition
known_counterexamples.mitigation_strategy: Cap claim class at SAMPLE_SPECIFIC / EXPLORATORY; explicitly disallow population generalization

proposition.statement: Negative binomial generalized linear models (DESeq2, edgeR) assume integer counts; continuous normalized floats violate dispersion estimation assumptions.
proposition.formal_predicate: forall y in Matrix: y in NonNegativeIntegers; Var(Y) = mu + alpha * mu^2
underlying_assumptions: Poisson-Gamma mixture distribution of sequencing read counts
Mean-variance relationship parameterizable by dispersion alpha

classification.rationale: Statistical theory: negative binomial models assume integer counts; feeding normalized floats distorts dispersion estimation, invalidating hypothesis testing.

normalized_matrix_only.source_citation: Love et al. 2014 (DESeq2); Robinson et al. 2010 (edgeR); Ritchie et al. 2015 (limma-voom)

supporting_evidence.note: Love, Huber & Anders 2014: Moderated estimation of fold change and dispersion for RNA-seq
Robinson, McCarthy & Smyth 2010: edgeR empirical Bayes dispersion estimation

applicable_regimes.description: Bulk RNA-seq and single-cell aggregated pseudobulk differential expression

known_counterexamples.description: Microarray or continuous intensity data modeled via limma-trend / limma-voom
known_counterexamples.boundary_mechanism: Limma-trend models log2 intensities directly with empirical Bayes variance smoothing
known_counterexamples.mitigation_strategy: Route to limma capability with continuous normality assumption

proposition.statement: Spatial statistical metrics (Moran's I, spatial neighborhood graphs) assume Euclidean physical tissue coordinates; UMAP/t-SNE latent embeddings do not represent physical adjacency.
proposition.formal_predicate: W_ij = f(d_phys(s_i, s_j)); d_phys in PhysicalMicronSpace
underlying_assumptions: Spatial stationarity and isotropy across local 2D tissue coordinate space
Distance decay weight matrix W constructed from calibrated physical coordinates
proposition.theoretical_framework: Spatial Autoregressive Processes & Spatial Point Patterns

classification.rationale: Spatial statistics: Moran's I assumes physical adjacency; embedding coordinates proxy for topological similarity which may correlate with but does not equal tissue-level structure.

spatial_coords_present.source_citation: Palla et al. 2022 (Squidpy); Li, Calder & Martin 2007 (Spatial statistics review)

supporting_evidence.note: Palla et al. 2022: Squidpy spatial single-cell analysis framework
Li, Calder & Martin 2007: Spatial autocorrelation and Moran's I weights

applicable_regimes.description: 2D and 3D spatial transcriptomics array and imaging technologies

proposition.statement: Single-cell cell-type assertions require verifiable orthogonal evidence (reference atlas projection, surface proteome, or expert marker panel); unsupervised cluster marker sorting alone is circular.
proposition.formal_predicate: P(CellType_c = T | Evidence_c) >= 0.80 where Evidence_c in {ReferenceAtlas, CITEseq, Panel}
underlying_assumptions: Marker expression in isolated clusters does not uniquely determine lineage identity without cross-dataset stability
Reference atlases (Azimuth, CellTypist) possess validated ground truth annotations

classification.rationale: Annotation evidence limits what identity claims can be justified; numeric clusters remain valid.

annotation_source_recorded.source_citation: Luecken et al. 2022 (Single-cell best practices); Abdelaal et al. 2019 (Annotation benchmark)

supporting_evidence.note: Luecken et al. 2022: Current best practices in single-cell RNA-seq analysis: a tutorial
Abdelaal et al. 2019: A comparison of automatic cell identification methods for single-cell RNA sequencing data

applicable_regimes.description: Cell-type annotation workflows in scRNA-seq and snRNA-seq

proposition.statement: Omics analysis software without CLIA/CAP certification and formal analytical validation cannot issue clinical diagnostic assertions or treatment directives for individual patients.
proposition.formal_predicate: forall p in Patients: ClinicalDiagnosis(p) requires CertifiedValidation(Pipeline)
underlying_assumptions: Research pipelines lack validated clinical sensitivity/specificity thresholds and chain-of-custody controls

classification.rationale: CLIA/CAP mandate: clinical diagnosis without certified validation directly impacts patient treatment decisions.

clinical_diagnosis_without_certification.source_citation: CLIA regulations (42 CFR Part 493); CAP accreditation checklists; EU IVDR 2017/746; FDA 21 CFR Part 11

proposition.statement: Joining disparate biological identifier namespaces without an explicit, versioned cross-reference dictionary causes silent data loss and spurious one-to-many gene mappings.
underlying_assumptions: HGNC symbols, Ensembl IDs, and Entrez IDs operate under distinct lifecycle and synonym update policies

classification.rationale: Data integrity: joining HGNC gene symbols against Ensembl IDs produces silent one-to-many mappings indistinguishable from correct joins.

identifier_namespace_mismatch.source_citation: Ensembl stable ID documentation; HGNC symbol lifecycle; BN-F004

supporting_evidence.note: Ensembl stable ID semantics differ from HGNC symbols

proposition.statement: Testing multiple hypotheses simultaneously across thousands of omics features without False Discovery Rate (FDR) adjustment inflates family-wise type I error.
underlying_assumptions: Independence or positive regression dependency of test statistics (PRDS assumption)

classification.rationale: Without FDR control, individual p-values are inflated false positives; exploratory ranking tolerates this. The 0.05 alpha is a community-convention default.

supporting_evidence.note: Benjamini & Hochberg 1995: Controlling the false discovery rate
Storey 2002: A direct approach to false discovery rates

applicable_regimes.description: Any high-dimensional hypothesis test with >= 10 features

known_counterexamples.description: Pre-registered hypothesis testing a single designated biomarker
known_counterexamples.boundary_mechanism: Family size m=1 does not require multiplicity correction
known_counterexamples.mitigation_strategy: Permit nominal p-value reporting if pre-registration artifact is attached

proposition.statement: A declared capability backend MUST be physically available and executed without silent substitution; if unavailable, the engine MUST fail closed.
underlying_assumptions: Different backend implementations produce divergent numerical results and edge-case behaviors

classification.rationale: Scientific capability contract: the canonical backend defines the algorithm. Silent substitution means the result is not what was advertised — zero silent substitution policy.

missing_backend.source_citation: Backend identity conformance (BNS-EF-012..016, BN-F010): declared == observed, no silent substitution
